'''Doberman''' is a mission in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] given to [[protagonist]] [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] by his brother, deuteragonist and [[Grove Street Families]] leader [[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]] from the entrance mark in front of [[Ammu-Nation]] in [[Market, Los Santos|Market]], [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]], [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]].

==Mission==
Carl receives a phone call from Sweet who tells him to go to Ammu-Nation in Market to get firearms and kill [[Little Weasel]], a former Grove Street Families gang member who betrayed them and has gone incognito with the [[Ballas]]. The traitor is hiding in [[Glen Park]]. Carl goes to Ammu-Nation, gets armed with weapons and heads over to Glen Park. He takes over Glen Park by surviving three waves of attacks from the Ballas. Carl then finds Little Weasel who claims that [[C.R.A.S.H.]] officer [[Frank Tenpenny]] set him up. Carl kills him and Glen Park now belongs to Grove Street.

== Pre-mission Phone Call ==

'''CJ''': What's up, Sweet?

'''Sweet''': We got a problem. Some punk ass bitch has been slinging onto his Grove brothers.

'''CJ''': What?

'''Sweet''': Check this out. He's been buying shit over in Glen Park. He know the hood's talking, and he's hiding out with his new Balla friends.

'''CJ''': Well, how we gonna get to him?

'''Sweet''': It's time for you to announce your return, CJ! You fuck up Glen Park, and that punk bitch-ass nigga's gonna lose nerve, and make a break for it.

'''CJ''': Okay, I'm a come pick you up.

'''Sweet''': Hell no! This is your gig, CJ. You need some stripes. Get over to Ammu-Nation, and get a heater.

==Script==
'''(''Carl goes to Ammu-Nation, then takes over the Glen Park hood and the traitor shows up.'')'''

'''Little Weasel''': Tenpenny set me up!

==Trivia==
* Originally, the mission was called '''[[All-Terrain Take Down|All-Terrain Takedown]]''', and the beta was a deleted mission for [[C.R.A.S.H.]] where Carl has to stop drug dealer [[Poncho]] from being arrested by investigating [[Officer Carver|officer Carver]].
* After this mission, [[Crack Dealers|crack dealers]] will become common around Los Santos, even appearing around Ganton, hinting the events in [[The Green Sabre]]. However, even after the player completes [[End of the Line]] and completely takes over all gang areas in the city, crack dealers will still spawn, indicating that they are either meant to spawn along with gang areas as part of in-game AI programming, or had either become so abundant between the events of [[Badlands]] and [[Home Coming]] that it was almost impossible to kill each and every one of them.
* According to the text in [[Los Sepulcros]], [[Grove Street Families]] defaulter [[Big Smoke|Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris]] was meant to be in this mission.

==Reward==
The reward for this mission is an increase in [[respect]]. The mission [[Los Sepulcros]] is unlocked. The player is also able to [[Gang Warfare in GTA San Andreas|take over enemy gang territories]], as well as enter Ammu-Nation to buy weapons from there.
